description: Trafic routier - Points de comptage permanents - Département du loiret - 2014 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Géolocalisation des points de comptage routier permanents accompagnés des indicateurs annuels de trafic (TMJA tous véhicules / Part des poids-lourds en pourcentage / TMJA poids-lourds) - Édition 2014. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Road traffic - Permanent counting points - Département du Loiret - 2014" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Données ouvertes, Mobilité, Points de comptage, Route, 2014. The listing shows 2022-04-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
